svg.text: A lower NOAK cost may never be achieved
Hypothetical costs and demand. Each design faces the same market independently.
1 Limited early demand can stop deployment
Electricity cost / customer willingness to pay ($/MWh)
Cumulative plants built (log scale; each doubling adds production experience)
Unrealized path after demand runs out

A needs no contract-price top-up. Support ends before B or C reaches its NOAK floor.
Each plant: 100 MW net, 90% capacity factor, 20-year flat-price contract. Constant 2025 dollars.
Chosen total-LCOE learning curves stop at an assumed floor. These are illustrations, not fusion forecasts.
